show.description: A decorated special forces commander, living incognito as a mechanic to escape his traumatic past, finds his secret life upended when he falls for a powerful CEO, forcing him to confront old enemies, a web of corporate conspiracies, and his own guilt to protect his new love and reclaim his destiny. Watch now.
